review_scope: Targeted rational product helper bodies and their three rational Horner callers; not a full source audit or current benchmark.
historical_evidence: INTERVAL_REFACTOR_PROGRESS.md: Rational Horner migration experiment; /tmp/interval-refactor/horner/production-timing-summary.json and candidate-borrowed.patch
decision: The plan still requires production common-kernel migration. The old rejection was decisive on size, but it also contains adverse rational-point timing and already tried validated nonempty owned/borrowed carriers. Bounded size permission alone does not qualify it or justify blindly repeating that design. A next implementation experiment needs a concrete lower-overhead boundary or current evidence resolving the adverse cost, plus all existing exact/dispatch/consumer gates. No production migration or performance acceptance is claimed.
